level_one.title: Burn The Impure
level_one.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level_four.title: Battle Hunger
level_four.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

level_seven.title: Flash of Anger
level_seven.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Wrath of the Angiris
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.  After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Pathetic Mortals
level_thirteen.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Swiftness
level_sixteen.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

level_twenty.title: Brand of Solarion
level_twenty.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Unstable Anomaly
level_four.description: Increase Polymorph's Slow by 15%. Upon expiration, Polymorph deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes equal to 2% of their maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Peekaboo!
level_seven.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Emerald Wind
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

level_thirteen.title: Pixie Boost
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's Movement Speed bonus to 50%, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Intensive Winds
level_twenty.description: Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.

level_one.title: Unrivaled Strength
level_one.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 125%.

level_four.title: Indomitable
level_four.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Intimidation
level_seven.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Warlord's Challenge
level_ten.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Bloodcraze
level_thirteen.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Mortal Combo
level_sixteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

level_twenty.title: Titanic Might
level_twenty.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

level_one.title: Furious Blow
level_one.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

level_four.title: Shattered Ground
level_four.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

level_seven.title: Poisoned Spear
level_seven.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

level_ten.title: Leap
level_ten.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: No Escape
level_thirteen.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Slammer
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

level_twenty.title: Arreat Crater
level_twenty.description: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds.  Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: In the Rhythm
level_four.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Drakken Laser Drill
level_ten.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: That's the Stuff!
level_thirteen.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

level_sixteen.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

level_twenty.title: Focusing Diodes
level_twenty.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

level_one.title: Wave of Light
level_one.description: Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.  Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.  Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_four.title: Holy Shock
level_four.description: Activate to deal 145 (+4% per level) damage to the target enemy, and gain the self-healing benefits of Holy Light. Shares a cooldown with Holy Light.

level_seven.title: Hand of Protection
level_seven.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Divine Shield
level_ten.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Well Met
level_thirteen.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Benediction
level_sixteen.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Bulwark of Light
level_twenty.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

level_one.title: Searing Light
level_one.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

level_four.title: Repeated Offense
level_four.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.  Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.  Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

level_seven.title: Empathic Link
level_seven.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

level_ten.title: Resurrect
level_ten.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

level_thirteen.title: Blinding Flash
level_thirteen.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Reservoir of Hope
level_sixteen.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

level_twenty.title: Shield of Hope
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

level_one.title: Enhanced Agility
level_one.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

level_four.title: One-Who-Collects
level_four.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_seven.title: Feeding Frenzy
level_seven.description: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.  Gambit: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds. Every death reduces this cooldown reduction by 0.25 seconds, up to 3 times.

level_ten.title: Isolation
level_ten.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ferocious Stalker
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 50% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level_sixteen.title: Tunneling Claws
level_sixteen.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 120%.

level_twenty.title: Contagion
level_twenty.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target, but it deals 60% less damage to all targets.

level_one.title: Recklessness
level_one.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 10% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

level_four.title: Troll's Blood
level_four.description: Increase Regeneration's healing by 25%. If Regeneration fully finishes, restore 10% of Zul'jin's maximum Mana.

level_seven.title: Ferocity
level_seven.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Berserker by 40%.

level_ten.title: Taz'dingo!
level_ten.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

level_thirteen.title: Eye of Zul'jin
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

level_sixteen.title: Let the Killing Begin
level_sixteen.description: When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration.  Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

level_twenty.title: Forest Medicine
level_twenty.description: Regeneration is no longer Channeled, and cannot be interrupted.

level_one.title: Justice for All
level_one.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

level_four.title: Stalwart Angel
level_four.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

level_seven.title: Swift Retribution
level_seven.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Sanctification
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Ground
level_thirteen.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

level_sixteen.title: Bound by Law
level_sixteen.description: El'Druin's Might's Slow is increased to 65% for 1 second, decaying to 30% over the remaining duration.

level_twenty.title: Holy Arena
level_twenty.description: Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.
